findings.text: non-blocking: _node_test_files re-implements the repository's test-path classifier is_test_path (reckon/crew/node.py:985), already used at promotion_checks.py:2015 for exactly this selection, with a narrower test_*.py rule, so a node scoped to tests/body_test.py is a check by dispatch's own definition (a negative control is required) yet resolves to no scoped file and promotion silently records no suite observation; delegate to is_test_path and to runs.py:1019 _repository_relative_scope.

non-blocking: the done_when's no-added-failure clause is not literally met, since head-arm.log ends 1 failed, 104 passed, EXIT=1; the host-contention attribution is supported (the id is a 5 s event wait and passed in 7.15 s on a single-test rerun) but the merged head is still owed a measurement by the separately dispatched test node.

item_verdicts.diff: Read both commits against dd2ef875a; the code commit adds the resolver and one call-site substitution in _evaluate_suite_delta (reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:426), the docs commit adds the landing fragment, and nothing outside the declared scope changed.
item_verdicts.done_when: The done_when names docs/state/reckon/flight.yaml and tests/test_the_consequence_gate_runs_the_nodes_tests.py; the manifest records 11 focused tests passing, a clean scoped pair, whole-suite and foreign-file refusals, and a declaration-removed control reddening two file-linked cases (negative-control.log ends 2 failed, 9 passed, EXIT=1).
item_verdicts.goal: The node goal is an armed promotion-consequence gate whose command resolves to the node's own fenced test files; reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:330-402 adds SCOPED_SUITE_PLACEHOLDER, _node_test_files and _scoped_suite_command, and docs/state/reckon/flight.yaml:124 declares the scoped command.
item_verdicts.manifest: Read; it names commits 8f6f24571 and 9803c15e2, the base arm (94 passed, EXIT=0) and the head arm (104 passed, 1 failed, EXIT=1) with their log paths, and attributes the single added id to host contention rather than to the change.
item_verdicts.write_paths: Read the manifest's five declared write paths; the diff touches four of them (flight.yaml, promotion_records.py, the test file, the landing fragment) and writes no figure, which the brief permits.

justifications.durability: tests/test_the_consequence_gate_runs_the_nodes_tests.py:254-260 and :281-307 compare against independent literals rather than the value under test, and negative-control.log shows two of them reddening when the declaration is removed.
justifications.evidence: tests/test_the_consequence_gate_runs_the_nodes_tests.py:281-307 records a clean scoped pair and :365-378 the unarmed case, but head-arm.log ends 1 failed, 104 passed against a done_when that asks for no added failure.
justifications.fit: promotion_records.py:333 and :380 sit beside _normalized_command at :320 in the same private-helper idiom with mechanism-based names and no plan or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/promotion_records.py:426 resolves the armed command before comparing either arm and docs/state/reckon/flight.yaml:124 arms reckon with the placeholder, so the gate the goal names is the gate that runs.
justifications.reuse: reckon/crew/node.py:985 already owns test-file classification and promotion_checks.py:2015 already selects a node's test paths with it, while promotion_records.py:362 re-implements a narrower rule instead of calling it.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff dd2ef875a..9803c15e2 touches only the four declared paths and creates no figure directory.
